once_moves_by_extension.statement: --once moves each top-level regular file into a subdirectory named after its lowercase extension and exits 0.
must_include: move files into subdirectories by extension

watch_organizes_new_files.statement: --watch keeps running and moves a file created after startup into its extension subdirectory.

moves_logged.statement: Each move appends a line with timestamp, source and destination to organizer.log in the target directory.

skips_files_in_subdirs.statement: Files already inside subdirectories are not moved and subdirectories are not descended into.

skips_hidden_files.statement: Files whose name starts with a dot are not moved.

single_file_stdlib_only.statement: organizer.py imports only standard library modules and needs no other project file.

collision_not_overwritten.statement: When the destination name exists, the moved file gets a numeric suffix and the existing file is unchanged.
must_include: move files into subdirectories by extension
